title: The touch lamp; a neat idea, and older than you'd think!
summary: Technology Connections explains how touch lamps work and traces them back through patents to the 1950s, far earlier than most people assume.
why: HN uses it as an example of Google's search answers confidently giving the wrong date for the invention.

quote.text: it'll pop up with a giant, confident answer of 1984, despite the fact that if you do the research yourself you can find the first patent for it was filed in 1954.
